stem:
Read lines 20 through 22 from the poem "Assembly."

Eyes closed, I wait for courage.
A whisper at first,
the music in me rises.

How do these lines support the theme of the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: By highlighting that an active imagination can be powerful

options.label: B
options.text: By suggesting that learning to be responsible is part of growing up

options.label: C
options.text: By suggesting that confidence often comes from within

options.label: D
options.text: By showing that recitals can bring people together
